## NPSphere 0.65.0 — first public release

Satisfaction and NPS surveys for **GLPI 11**, answered with one click from the email. Built and tested in 11 phases:

**1. Foundation** — Plugin structure for GLPI 11 (PSR-4, Twig, hooks), surveys with full create/edit/delete, menu under Administration, clean install and uninstall.

**2. Questions** — 7 types: NPS (0–10 or 0–5), emoticons, stars, yes/no, single choice, multiple choice and text. Drag-and-drop ordering and a live preview in the editor.

**3. Answers** — One page or one question per step, validation per type, required questions, deadlines and duplicate control. A **Preview** tab that never saves.

**4. Results** — NPS, average score (0–10) and classification, per-question results, searchable and filterable answer list, individual answer view, print/PDF.

**5. Conditional questions** — Show a question only for certain answers (=, ≠, <, ≤, >, ≥), checked both in the browser and on the server.

**6. External surveys** — Public link with a 256-bit token, optional identification (name, email, international phone) or fully anonymous answers.

**7. Internal surveys** — Target audience by entity, profile, group, user or everyone. **My surveys** page, self-service portal support and an optional **mandatory** pop-up after login.

**8. Ticket surveys** — Replaces GLPI's native satisfaction survey: shown inside the closed ticket, only the requester answers, once per ticket, one survey per entity if needed. The score is also written to GLPI's `glpi_ticketsatisfactions`.

**9. Emails** — Invitation, reminder, daily report and immediate low-score alert, each with an editable template, live preview and variables. **One-click answer** from the email through personal signed links, without login. Everything goes through GLPI's mail queue and automatic actions. Clone surveys the GLPI way (Actions › Clone) and pages that work well on phones.

**10. Dashboard** — Consolidated NPS, monthly trend, comparison with the previous period and breakdowns by survey, entity, requester, technician, group and category. Click a row to filter.

**11. Finishing touches** — Export to **Excel (.xlsx)**, **LibreOffice (.ods)** and CSV; **exceptions** in the target audience ("the Finance group, except its manager"); change **history** in GLPI's Historical tab; per-IP **rate limiting** on pages without login; full **English** translation (`en_GB`, `en_US`) next to Brazilian Portuguese; dates and numbers in GLPI's own formats.

**Security:** each person manages only the surveys they created (administrators see all), CSRF on every form, signed email links, links to results only for those who can open them.

**Install:** extract `npsphere-0.65.0.zip` into GLPI's `marketplace/` (or `plugins/`) folder, then go to **Setup › Plugins**, install and enable **NPSphere**. Requires GLPI 11 and PHP 8.1+.
